description.value:
As an action, you can initiate a Saber Storm, selecting a light- or vibro-weapon within 5 feet that no conscious creature other than you is wielding or wearing, and lifting it into the air with the Force to act on your behalf for up to 1 minute. Activating the feature lets you move the weapon up to 10 feet and make a melee force attack with it against a creature within 5 feet of its new position, dealing 1d8 plus your forcecasting ability modifier damage of the weapon's normal type on a hit; the weapon then returns to hover beside you.

The animated weapon travels with you, and on each of your turns while Saber Storm is active you can spend your action to move it (or one of your weapons) up to 10 feet and repeat the attack, after which it returns to your side. The effect ends early if you're incapacitated, and you can end it voluntarily at any time to recall the weapon to your hand.

Whenever Saber Storm is active and at least one animated weapon is within 5 feet of you, you also gain a bonus to your AC equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum +1, and only if that modifier isn't already counted), plus an identical bonus to Constitution saving throws made to maintain concentration on a power.

You can animate more weapons as you advance: two at 5th level, three at 11th level, and four at 17th level. When attacking with multiple animated weapons on your turn, you may split them among different targets, rolling a separate attack for each. The distance each weapon can travel also grows, to 20 feet at 5th level, 30 feet at 11th level, and 40 feet at 17th level.

You can use this feature twice, with all uses restored after a short or long rest.
